A small '''bazaar''' was located near the former studio of [[Ves Volette]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Dejah Duare]] bought [[takhal nut]]s and [[sweet ice]] at the bazaar for [[Kajin Savaros]].
